title: NHK きょうの料理 — 肉じゃが (Today's Cooking: Nikujaga)
description: From NHK's long-running cooking programme きょうの料理 (Today's Cooking), first broadcast 1957 and continuing to the present — Japan's longest-running cooking show. This episode demonstrates nikujaga (肉じゃが), the quintessential Japanese home-cooked comfort dish of meat and potato simmered in dashi and soy sauce. Cooking vocabulary at N4 level.
creator: NHK きょうの料理
